- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 3D game themed “3D Portal, but you can only place one portal.”

- Deliver a playable game, making reasonable assumptions without clarification.

- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks.

- Built a first-person sci-fi puzzle chamber: place one portal on a brass receiver, cross the fixed portal, collect three memory cores, and return to extraction.

- Build a complete, playable, mobile-friendly 3D game themed “3D Portal, but you can only place one portal.”

- Support phones and tablets with touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, with viewport width no greater than 1280px.

- First-person sci-fi puzzle chamber: place one portal on a brass receiver, cross the fixed cyan gate, collect three memory cores, and return to extraction.
